question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate synonym of the underlined word.**

I believe you are **__impartial__ **while making decisions
solution: The correct answer is** "Fair."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **"Impartial" **means not biased or prejudiced. (जिसमें दो पक्षों में से किसी एक को अधिक प्रमुखता न दी जाए; निष्‍पक्ष) • **Example**: *The judge was **impartial**__ in his ruling, considering all the evidence presented to him.* • The synonym of **"impartial" **is **"fair."** • **"Fair" **means appropriate and acceptable in a particular situation. (उचित, सही) __ • **Example**: *Her decision was **fair**__.* • *​*So, the correct answer is Option 2. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **Option 1, "Biased," **means having a preference or inclination towards one side. (किसी एक पक्ष की ओर प्राथमिकता या झुकाव होना) • **Option 3, "Good,"** means of a high quality or standard. (उच्‍च गुणवत्ता या स्‍तर का, अच्‍छा) • **Option 4, "Offensive,"** means unpleasant; insulting. (अप्रिय; अपमानजनक) 33:T7b3, The correct answer is **"appeared for the accused."**
